{{Quote|My father owed Davik some money, but he couldn't pay. Davik killed my father and sold me into slavery here at the Vulkar compound to pay off the debt.|Ada, to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The '''father''' of the<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Gender">Game files from ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' establish [[Ada]] as having a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] head model.</ref> [[Ada]] was a man who owed [[Currency/Legends|money]] to [[Davik Kang]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime-lord]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Kang worked for the [[Exchange]], a powerful criminal organization, and was the head of its operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. After Ada's [[Parent/Legends|father]] was unable to pay him back, Kang had the man [[Death/Legends|killed]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] Ada. Kang sold Ada to the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] to satisfy the debt.<ref name="KOTOR" /> She<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> remained enslaved during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic}}
In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], whose memories had been [[Amnesia/Legends|lost]] and replaced with those of a [[Republic soldier]], encountered Ada working as a [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] in the [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gang's [[Black Vulkar Base|compound]]. After killing the [[Security guard/Legends|guards]] in the area,<ref name="KOTOR" /> he<ref name="Campaign guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> talked with her, and she explained her situation, including her father's death. Revan asked Ada questions about the Vulkars and then allowed her to leave the base.<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|No&mdash;I won't go out like this! Not after all I've been through! I won't just let you kill me without a fight!|Ada, to Revan, in potential dialogue|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
Ada's father was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. The mention occurs during optional dialogue with Ada. Completing "The Search for Bastila" quest causes Ada to disappear, and the player can no longer access the dialogue. During this dialogue, the player may choose to free or kill Ada. The former choice gives the player [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] points. If the player chooses to kill Ada, she will fight back and the player will shift towards the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. If Republic [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Carth Onasi]] is one of the companions in the player's party when they attempt to kill Ada, he will prevent them from doing so and allow Ada to leave.<ref name="KOTOR" />
